task: Multi-platform coordination upgrade for Codex, Claude, GitHub, GLM and DeepSeek
intent: Make local coordination reliable and connect agent clients and model review providers through evidence-bound, reviewable artifacts.
core_changes: Atomic shared-worktree Manager state, normalized advisory leases, expiry, renewal and holder checks
Robust synchronous stdio MCP requests with eight tools and explicit legacy protocol compatibility
Native isolated-launch configuration generation for Codex, Claude Code and GitHub Copilot
Read-only GitHub PR metadata handoff with complete base/head commit IDs
Claude Messages, GLM and DeepSeek adapters with explicit models and opt-in network requests
Committed diff evidence, validated advisory results and draft integration plans with stale-reference checks

contracts.name: Default Manager state
contracts.compatibility: Shared at primary worktree; explicit --state-dir remains caller-controlled. Competing legacy logs require reconciliation.

contracts.name: Raw lease and decision events
contracts.compatibility: These mutations now require dedicated commands; legacy raw event scripts must migrate.

contracts.name: Lease lifecycle
contracts.compatibility: Conservative path normalization, expiry and renewal; legacy leases without expiry retained.

contracts.name: Review and GitHub context artifacts
contracts.compatibility: Preview formats; model advice never authorizes integration.

contracts.name: Existing JSON schemas
contracts.compatibility: Retained; new integration plans conform to current integration-plan schema.

tests: Full unittest suite, including concurrent processes and real temporary Git worktrees
MCP malformed input isolation, protocol versions and multi-client lease lifecycle
Provider protocol/error tests with mocked HTTP only
Generated client configuration parsing and actual subprocess stdio handshake
Evidence path exclusion, draft safety, output preservation and stale/tampered review rejection
Config, manifest, artifact JSON/YAML and package build validation; see validation.md for final results
risks: Protected CLI, package and CI changes require maintainer review before merge/release
External model service authentication, model availability and billing not tested with live calls
Local advisory coordination is not an identity boundary or a distributed lock service
Glob comparison is conservative and may produce false positives
Filename-based sensitive-content exclusion does not detect every secret inside source code
Draft integration plans still require human decisions and trusted validation commands
